from __future__ import annotations
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
MAIN = ROOT / 'main.py'

def case(name: str, data: bytes, args: list[str], code: int, stdout: str | None = None, stderr_has: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p = Path(d) / 'input.csv'
        p.write_bytes(data)
        before = p.read_bytes()
        r = subprocess.run(['python3', str(MAIN), str(p), *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert r.returncode == code, (name, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
        if stdout is not None:
            assert r.stdout == stdout, (name, r.stdout, stdout)
        for text in stderr_has:
            assert text.lower() in r.stderr.lower(), (name, text, r.stderr)
        assert p.read_bytes() == before, f'{name}: input modified'

case('quoted and embedded newline', b'a,b\\r\\n1,\"x,y\"\\r\\n2,\"u\\r\\nv\"\\r\\n', [], 0,
     '[\\n  {\\n    \"a\": \"1\",\\n    \"b\": \"x,y\"\\n  },\\n  {\\n    \"a\": \"2\",\\n    \"b\": \"u\\\\r\\\\nv\"\\n  }\\n]\\n')
